definitions.explanation: A person who accompanies someone, especially as a servant or escort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{殿様|とのさま}→殿様：10455_tonosama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{供|とも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The lord set out on a journey with his attendants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{供|とも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went shopping with my child accompanying me.

examples.japanese: {供|とも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: There were three people in the retinue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{供|とも}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つ}れていった→連れていく：23753_tsureteiku⟧。
examples.english: I took a dog along as a travel companion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{供|とも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I attended the party with my wife accompanying me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{供|とも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}った→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: I climbed the mountain with a friend accompanying me.

notes:
{供|とも} refers to someone who accompanies another person, often in a subordinate role. It has a somewhat classical or formal feel.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {供|とも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つ}れる→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧: to bring attendants/companions
- {供|とも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accompany someone (as an attendant)
- お{供|とも}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accompany (humble form)

NOTE: This word appears in ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧ (child), though the connection is historical. The character {供|とも} can also be a pluralizing suffix (e.g., ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧{供|ども} = we, humble).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連|つ}れ→連れ：03534_tsure⟧: companion (more casual)
- ⟦{随行|ずいこう}→随行：noentry⟧: accompanying (formal, for officials)
